instructions.subtitle_card: Step onto the court and play normally. Our smart cameras record everything.
Press the court button or use the app to save that incredible play.
The video is processed instantly and sent straight to your phone.
Save it, relive it, and share every point. Post it on social media, show your friends, and relive your best highlights.

section_faq.title: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
section_faq.subtitle: Get answers about how ElitePlay works in sports arenas.

itens.question: What infrastructure is required to install in my arena?
itens.answer: Only a power outlet and internet connection. All remaining hardware is provided and installed by ElitePlay.

itens.question: How long does installation take?
itens.answer: Standard installation takes about 1 day per court without disrupting scheduled games.

itens.question: How do players access their videos?
itens.answer: Players download the ElitePlay app, sign up, and find their saved videos filtered by date, time, and court.
